g.text: the dydra credential. Authenticated per request
per resource, then again at transaction creation.
the provider credential. Reaches the Messages API
= the user's authority ∩ ALLOW_TOOLS. The model
has no credential and no route to the endpoint; it asks,
and edge 16 is the browser answering on its behalf.
bearer token of edge 6c is permanent, unscoped and
account-wide. Both are what OAuth scopes would move
to the server — on the blue boundary only; the orange
one keeps its bearer token. See
edge 19e: whatever the model surveys is sent to the
provider. Repository read authority is not a bound on
